subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader branch be designated as the canonical fix for both the Tavily fallback and agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot failures, superseding the Tavily-only alternative after exact-head validation?
rationale: Both implementations have positive proof, while this branch also changes a shared agent runtime path and is currently behind main; canonical ownership and acceptance of the broader scope require maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the broader fix
options.body: Rebase and validate this branch, then merge it as the single canonical repair for both ownership layers and close the overlapping Tavily-only PR.

options.title: Land Tavily only
options.body: Use the narrower Tavily fallback PR and move the agent Tool Search snapshot repair into a separately reviewed change.

options.title: Pause both branches
options.body: Keep the issue open while redesigning runtime snapshot ownership if maintainers do not want the new shared agent helper.

recommendation.title: Land the broader fix
recommendation.body: Rebase and validate this branch, then merge it as the single canonical repair for both ownership layers and close the overlapping Tavily-only PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The assignment, force-push activity, and authorship of the reviewed squashed commit make this person the clearest available owner for the final scope and canonical-branch choice.
